note: On four of five criteria this is close to the textbook case: 40 years old, already lean and eating clean, sits at a desk eight hours a day so health is precisely the neglected corner, and he wants definition and longevity rather than rescue — 'I have like a lean physique. It's just that I want to shed around the midsection.' Price was never an affordability problem; he treated $6,000 as a value comparison against an in-home trainer and paid on the call. 'Successful' is recorded as a miss because it was never established rather than because it was disproven — the rep asked how many hours he sits and how many steps he takes but never asked what he actually does for a living, so the ICP's occupation test cannot be evaluated. That omission has now appeared in three of four sales calls in this batch.
